**Company:** Eclat Globalbiz Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Shyamal Cross Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Department:** International Sales & Business Development  
**Experience:** 3–5 years in Export Sales / International Business  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Export Sales professional to expand our international business for baby and kids’ ethnic wear and related apparel products. The candidate will be responsible for developing overseas markets, identifying international buyers, building distributor and retail partnerships, generating export orders, and managing the complete export sales cycle.

Key Responsibilities

**1. International Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in international markets.
* Generate leads and establish relationships with overseas buyers, importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and buying houses.
* Explore potential markets through online platforms, trade directories, exhibitions, and international business networks.
* Develop and execute strategies to increase export sales and expand the company’s global presence.

**2. B2B Sales & Client Management**

* Promote the company’s baby and kids’ ethnic wear and apparel product range to international buyers.
* Share product catalogues, pricing, samples, quotations, and company presentations with prospective clients.
* Negotiate pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQs), payment terms, and delivery schedules.
* Build long-term relationships with existing clients and follow up on repeat business opportunities.

**3. Export Order Management**

* Coordinate with internal teams for product availability, costing, production timelines, quality checks, packaging, and dispatch.
* Follow up on export orders from confirmation to shipment and delivery.
* Coordinate with logistics partners, freight forwarders, customs agents, and relevant internal stakeholders.
* Ensure timely execution of orders as per agreed customer requirements.

**4. Export Documentation & Compliance Coordination**

* Coordinate the preparation of export documents, including commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, certificates of origin, and other applicable documents.
* Ensure coordination for customs clearance, shipping arrangements, and applicable export procedures.
* Work with finance and logistics teams for payment follow-ups, foreign currency transactions, and export documentation.
* Coordinate documentation as per applicable export regulations and Incoterms.

**5. Market Research & Reporting**

* Research international market trends, competitor pricing, customer preferences, and emerging business opportunities.
* Maintain a database of international prospects, buyers, quotations, and sales pipelines.
* Prepare regular reports on enquiries, conversion rates, order bookings, sales performance, and market development.
* Achieve assigned export sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in export sales, preferably in garments, textiles, fashion, or apparel.
* Strong understanding of international B2B sales, export procedures, shipping documentation, and Incoterms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, and CRM or sales tracking tools.
* Good written and spoken English; knowledge of additional foreign languages will be an advantage.
* Willingness to work with international clients across different time zones and travel for exhibitions or client meetings when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly and annual export sales revenue.
* Number of new international buyers acquired.
* Number of qualified leads and conversion rate.
* Number and value of export orders secured.
* Repeat business and client retention.
* Timely order execution and payment collection.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in international sales of babywear, kidswear, ethnic wear, garments, textiles, or fashion products will be preferred. Experience in developing overseas distributor networks and handling end-to-end export sales will be an added advantage.

**Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and relevant export sales experience.**

title: Sales Executive
description:
**What you will be selling**

This is a SaaS sale, not a product or commodity sale. You are selling a subscription\-based software platform to business owners who are used to doing things manually. You must be comfortable selling technology, running a live demo, and explaining a system, not just quoting a price.

Our company is a recurring\-revenue software platform with a web app and mobile app. Your prospects are pharmacy owners, district managers, and head\-office operations leaders, most of whom are not technical. Your job is to make a software solution sound simple, obvious, and worth switching to. If you have sold SaaS, IT services, or any technology product before, this will feel familiar. If you have only ever sold physical goods, this role will be a hard jump.

**The role — read this part carefully**

This is a phone\-first role. The majority of your day will be spent on the phone, cold calling pharmacy owners, managers, and decision\-makers across Canada. If you are not comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day, please do not apply.

You will own the full sales cycle — building your own call list, making the calls, handling objections on the spot, running the software demo, following up relentlessly, and closing the subscription. You will be the first voice a Canadian pharmacy hears from our company, so your English, your tone, and your ability to think on your feet directly determine whether we win that account or lose it.

This is not a role for someone who needs hand\-holding. We want someone who is self\-motivated, thinks creatively, takes initiative, and brings energy to the work every day.

**What you will do**

* Make a high volume of cold calls every day to pharmacy owners, managers, and head\-office decision\-makers across Canada. This is the core of the job, not a side task.
* Handle objections live on the call — price, timing, "we already have an agency", "we don't want another app", "send me an email", "not interested". You need answers ready and the confidence to keep the conversation going.
* Run online product demos over Zoom or Teams — walk a prospect through the platform, answer functional and basic technical questions, and connect features to the problems that pharmacies are actually facing.
* Learn the product deeply — you are expected to know the platform well enough to answer most questions yourself without escalating to the technical team.
* Own the end\-to\-end sales process — prospecting, calling, qualification, demo, negotiation, onboarding paperwork, and closing.
* Follow up by email, WhatsApp, and phone until you get a clear yes or a clear no. Deals are lost on follow\-up, not on the first call.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline in the CRM; keep call notes, statuses, and next steps accurate and up to date every day.
* Report your own numbers — calls made, connects, demos booked, and deals closed — without being chased for them.
* Feed real market objections and feature requests back to the product team so the platform keeps improving.
* Collaborate with the Client Success team to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding of new clients after signing.

**What we are looking for**

**Non\-negotiable requirements — please only apply if all of these apply to you.**

**SaaS or IT product and services sales experience — minimum 2 years actively selling software, subscriptions, platforms, apps, or IT services. Not lead generation for a software company; actual selling. Tell us what you sold, who you sold it to, and what the subscription or contract value was.**

**Ability to demo software confidently — you can run a screen\-share walkthrough of a platform, explain how it works to a non\-technical business owner, and handle questions such as "how does it integrate", "is our data safe", and "what if my staff can't use it" without freezing.**

**Comfort with technology — CRM, dialer, Zoom or Teams, shared docs, WhatsApp Business. You should be the kind of person who figures out a new tool on their own rather than waiting for training.**

**Excellent spoken English — clear pronunciation, neutral accent, and confident delivery. You will be on live calls with Canadian pharmacy owners and executives throughout the day. Weak or hesitant English will not work in this role, no exceptions.**

**Strong objection\-handling skills — you can stay calm when someone says no, ask the right question back, and turn a cold response into a conversation.**

**Proven cold calling experience — you have done outbound calling as a daily habit, not occasionally, and you can tell us your typical daily call volume.**

**Honesty and integrity — you report your numbers accurately, tell us when something did not get done, and never overstate a lead's interest to look good on a report.**

**Accountability and ownership — you own your targets and your results. When something goes wrong, you come with the problem and a plan, not an excuse.**

**Responsiveness is mandatory — you reply to emails, WhatsApp messages, texts, and calls from clients and from the team promptly during working hours. If you are someone who leaves messages unread and calls unreturned, this role is not for you.**

**Work ethic — this is a demanding, target\-driven role with real earning upside for people who put in the effort. If you are looking for an easy desk job where you can coast, please do not apply.**

**Onsite availability — this role is based at our office in Sargasan, Gandhinagar. Remote work is not available for this position.**

**Scheduling flexibility — our clients are in Canada. Calls and meetings will need to be scheduled in alignment with Canadian time zones, including Eastern and Pacific time zones. You must be genuinely flexible with your working hours on those days.**

**Punctuality and reliability — missed follow\-ups and late responses cost us deals. You must be disciplined, organised, and on time — always.**

**Strongly preferred**

Healthcare, staffing, HR tech, or marketplace SaaS experience — selling workforce, scheduling, HRMS, or ERP software is the closest match to what we do.

Experience with subscription and recurring\-revenue selling — you understand that the sale is not finished at signup and that renewals depend on how you set expectations up front.

Experience selling SaaS or IT services into North American markets — Canada or the US.

Hands\-on experience with CRM and sales technology — HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator (MUST), or similar.

Understanding of basic SaaS sales metrics — pipeline stages, conversion rates, MRR, and churn.

**Compensation**

**Base Salary:** Competitive fixed monthly salary.

**Commission:** Performance\-based commission with uncapped earning potential.

**Monthly Targets**

Your base salary covers your fixed monthly income. On top of that, you earn commission on every deal you close — the more you sell, the more you earn. There is no cap on what you can make. Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

**Why join our company**

* Sell a real technology product that is solving a genuine problem for healthcare businesses across Canada.
* Build international SaaS sales experience and exposure to Canadian market dynamics — without leaving Ahmedabad.
* Work in a small team where your contribution has high visibility and your impact is tangible from day one.
* Have a direct line to the product team — what you hear on calls can actually shape the product roadmap.
* Be part of a culture that values ownership, outcomes, and honesty over processes and hierarchy.
* Have real earning potential through a commission structure that rewards results, not just effort.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month
